name: WF-254 — Property-Level Offer Strategy → Seller Offer Package & Negotiation Launch

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const decision=String(d.acquisition_decision??"").toLowerCase();const mao=Number(d.dynamic_mao??d.adjusted_mao??NaN),asking=Number(d.asking_price??NaN);const projected_profit=Number(d.projected_assignment_profit??NaN);const motivation=String(d.motivation??"unknown").toLowerCase();const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let status="needs_review",reason="Seller offer package requires review.",next="WF-126",offer=null; if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){status="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(!["pursue","negotiate"].includes(decision)){status="not_offer_ready";reason="Acquisition decision does not support an offer package.";next="WF-253";}else if(!Number.isFinite(mao)||mao<=0||blockers.length){status="blocked";reason=blockers.length?"Deal blockers must be resolved before preparing an offer.":"Valid dynamic MAO is required.";next="WF-126";}else{const target=decision==="pursue"?Math.min(Number.isFinite(asking)?asking:mao,mao):Math.min(mao,Number.isFinite(asking)?Math.max(asking*0.9,0):mao);const opening=decision==="negotiate"?Math.min(target,mao*0.92):target;offer={offer_price:Math.round(opening),negotiation_target:Math.round(target),mao_ceiling:Math.round(mao),asking_price:Number.isFinite(asking)?asking:null,projected_assignment_profit:Number.isFinite(projected_profit)?projected_profit:null,motivation,decision};status="offer_package_ready";reason="Seller offer package prepared within dynamic MAO protection.";next="WF-255";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-254",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,acquisition_decision:decision,status,reason,offer_package:offer,requires_human_review:true,next_workflow:next,guardrails:{dynamic_mao_primary:true,offer_must_not_exceed_mao:true,rule_70_percent:"secondary_reference_only"}}}];
